# Genixo

> Genixo Bilişim ve Teknoloji A.Ş. (Genixo) is a software and AI engineering company based in Bilkent Cyberpark, Ankara, Türkiye. It works as an external software department for SMEs and organizations, covering AI process automation with human approval, custom software, product development and NGSD, an ongoing software team model.

Genixo Bilişim ve Teknoloji A.Ş. — Bilkent Cyberpark, Cyberplaza H Blok No:8, Çankaya, Ankara, Türkiye. Tel: +90 312 265 04 56. Email: hello@genixo.ai

Working principle: AI suggests, your team approves. Every AI step that changes a record, a price or a customer message is reviewed by a person before it takes effect.

## Services
- [Services overview](https://genixo.ai/en/services): Four ways to work with Genixo and how to choose between them.
- [AI process automation with human approval](https://genixo.ai/en/ai-automation): Document processing, quote drafting, matching, call analysis and knowledge assistants, with a person approving each output.
- [Custom software and ERP integration](https://genixo.ai/en/custom-software): Software built around an existing process and connected to the systems already in use.
- [Product studio](https://genixo.ai/en/product-studio): From idea to a live web or mobile app, starting with a small first version.
- [NGSD: external software department](https://genixo.ai/en/ngsd): An ongoing software and AI team that works on your roadmap every month.
